g: A flying skein of geese or other birds which have placed themselves in a V-shaped formation.
(UK, Ireland) A V-sign; by extension, an insult or show of defiance.
The impact was so strong, it bent the bar into a v.
A V-shaped arm in a videocassette recorder that threads the tape of the videocassette around the head.

(automotive) An internal combustion engine configuration consisting of two cylinder banks—usually with the same number of cylinders in each bank—connected to a common crankshaft, and arranged at an angle to each other so as to form a V shape when viewed from the front of the engine.
A chevron-shaped formation of flying birds or aircraft, used in particular by many migrating birds such as geese.
(particle physics) Any heavy, unstable subatomic particle that decays into a pair of particles, thereby producing a characteristic letter V in a bubble chamber or other detector.
A sign of victory or peace made by raising the index and middle fingers with the palm outwards.

(chiefly UK, Ireland, Commonwealth) A gesture of contempt or insult made by raising the index and middle fingers with the palm inwards; apocryphally originated by English bowmen at Agincourt (in actuality attested only from 1901).
(aviation) Any of a group of standard airspeeds.
A triad in which one person is in a polyamorous relationship with two other people who are not in a relationship with each other.

(automotive, engineering) Referring to an internal combustion engine piston cylinder configuration, where the cylinders are aligned in a V-like shape, in which there is an acute angle between the cylinders, and the bottom of the cylinder, where the crank is, is the bottom of the V, and the top of t…
Vietnamese; used to form nouns relating to the (popular) culture of Vietnam.
(grammar, X-bar theory) A type of entity in X-bar theory, denoting the verb in a constructed sentence.
(nautical) An approximately V-shaped berth at the extreme forward end of the hull, usually in a separate cabin called the forepeak.
(television) Any censorship technology that allows parents to control the level of objectionable content that their children may see on television.

(LGBTQ) The placement of incarcerated trans women in cells with aggressive cisgender male inmates (who will physically or sexually assault the trans women) as a form of reward or pacification for the male inmates and abuse of the trans women.
Cut into a V shape, especially describing the neckline of clothing.
A cut or incision in the shape of a letter V.
(sports) An evasive manoeuvre in which a player makes a sharp turn to run back on themselves.
The V shape made by the lower abdominal muscles above the pubis.
(linguistics) A second-person pronoun used in formal situations, to address unfamiliar people and superiors.
(UK, education) A proposed vocational qualification for 16-year-olds.
(fashion) Cut in the shape of a "V", producing a flared effect.
A line in the shape of the letter "V".
Moxostoma pappillosum, a freshwater catostomid fish of eastern North America.

(historical) A postal mail system used in America during World War II for correspondence with soldiers stationed abroad. Letters were censored, copied to film, and printed back onto paper at their destination.
(zoology) A common grey European moth, Macaria wauaria, with a V-shaped spot of dark brown on each forewing.
(fashion) A V-shaped neckline on a garment such as a pullover, usually at the front of the garment.
(linguistics) A perfect stem of a Latin verb which has been formed by adding a v or u to the end of the present stem.
a vaginal or intravaginal ring that releases hormones for the purpose of contraception
Shaped like the letter V; especially, designating one of the two major types of valley (the other being U-shaped), typically formed by flowing water.
(metonymic) Characterized by traits whose graphing produces curves with that shape.
(geomorphology) A valley that resembles the letter V and is formed by erosion from a river or stream over time.
A two-cylinder internal combustion engine with the cylinders arranged in a V-shaped configuration.
(metonymic) A vehicle with such an engine; (especially), a motorcycle with such an engine.
(humorous) Any word beginning with v that is not normally taboo but is considered (often humorously) to be so in the given context.
(abbreviation, initialism) Used to introduce an example or list of examples to illustrate what is being discussed.
(grammar) verb intransitive or intransitive verb (often appears in dual language dictionaries)
